messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: p99 latency 1.42s > SLO 1.0s for service inference-gateway-eu-west. Paging rotation eng-oncall-eu.
pd-bot: Incident 12345 — pager fired to eng-oncall-eu. Priority: P1.
maya: ack — I'm on it, ETA 2m to triage.
alex: looking at dashboards — p99 spike aligns with batch queue depth and kv-cache MISS rate up ~18%.
maya: no deploys in last 30m. autoscaler shows scale-up throttled by node quota in eu-west-region.
sasha: any immediate mitigation we can do besides scaling?
alex: quick: scale gateway to 8 replicas and route small models for latency-sensitive routes.
maya: scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=8`
maya: routing change: enable fallback route policy `fallback-lt` for route /v1/generate (will steer to quantized-llama-small)
incident-bot: PagerDuty: maya acknowledged incident 12345.
pd-bot: If not resolved in 10m, escalation to sasha -> oncall-2 will occur.
jordan: preparing cache warmup job — will send curl prefixes to warm KV.
maya: customer impact: tail latency for ~2.3% requests > 5s; errors minimal (0.1% 5xx) but degraded UX for some power users.
sasha: notifying support to prepare banner/PSA.
support-bot: Created support ticket INC-4567 and linked affected customers list.
alex: added a temporary traffic split: 90% primary, 10% fallback. Watching metrics.
maya: after scaling p99 dropped to 0.98s, p95 steady. continuing to monitor.
jordan: cache-warm job done; KV hitrate up +12% in last 2m.
sasha: good, please keep PD status updated and collect at least one flamegraph.
maya: collecting flamegraph now — attaching perf snippet link https://internal/redwood/perf/12345
maya: handing off — I need to step out in 15m. Jordan takes primary.
jordan: ack taking over. will keep PD updated and follow runbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/latency-burn
pd-bot: Incident 12345 status: acknowledged -> investigating. Last updated by jordan.
incident-bot: Incident 12345: silence window set for automated paging for 15m to reduce noise while we stabilize.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
